name: modaward-mobile
description: ModaWard for iOS and Android: native shells around the same web app that runs on modaward.com.

scripts.assets: cd tools && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && node make-assets.mjs && cd .. && ./tools/node_modules/.bin/capacitor-assets generate --iconBackgroundColor '#1f3d33' --iconBackgroundColorDark '#1f3d33' --splashBackgroundColor '#f6f3ed' --splashBackgroundColorDark '#100f0d' && rm -rf icons www/manifest.json ios/App/App/Assets.xcassets/Splash.imageset/splash-2732x2732*.png
scripts.sync: node scripts/prepare-www.mjs && cap sync && node scripts/set-native-version.mjs
scripts.ios: npm run sync && cap open ios
scripts.android: npm run sync && cap open android
